schemaRows.value: The beginning terminus of an interaction.
The ending terminus of an interaction.

An entity representing any product of a given gene, including DNA, RNA and Protein. This is the most generic representation of a gene-based biomolecule and is useful when more than one representation might be useful in the given context.
A binding interaction between two physical entities resulting in the formation of an explicit complex that is reversible without an external factor (e.g. protein complexes).

queries.membership: PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?entity ?pathway ?wpid ?title WHERE { ?entity wp:bdbEnsembl <https://identifiers.org/ensembl/ENSG00000141510>; dcterms:isPartOf ?pathway . ?pathway a wp:Pathway; wp:organismName "Homo sapiens"; dcterms:identifier ?wpid; dc:title ?title . }
queries.interactions: PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?interaction ?pathway ?type WHERE { ?tp wp:bdbEnsembl <https://identifiers.org/ensembl/ENSG00000141510> . ?interaction (wp:source|wp:target|wp:participants) ?tp; dcterms:isPartOf ?pathway; a ?type . ?pathway a wp:Pathway; wp:organismName "Homo sapiens" . }
